show.name: Noble Reincarnation: Born Blessed, So I'll Obtain Ultimate Power
show.summary: Noah, the world's strongest six-year-old, has been privileged enough to be reborn as the emperor's 13th child. What's more, he's been overpowered with an infinite level cap and a cheat that stacks the powers of anyone who serves him. But even privilege has its problems—the glittering facade of high society hides a world of conspiracies, schemes, and power struggles.
